dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey cutie, we meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This place sure wasn't easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, really? I used to live in Sumeru City and now that I'm back, I can't help but want to visit these small, remote shops.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's a pity that my old favorite clothing shop has already been closed for some time.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I wanted to buy some accessories and clothes to give to the other ladies in the Knights of Favonius. Hmm... what a pity.

choices.text: I see you bought some new clothes.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I was wondering when you would notice. Well, what do you think?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It's always nice to hear compliments from other people, especially you. Thank you, cutie.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I managed to find the owner of that old clothing shop and had it custom tailored.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Wearing it reminds me of my days at the Akademiya. What a busy time that was for me...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: However, my researchers were never lazy, unlike the people who borrow books and don't return them. Now that I think of it, punishing them with a zap of Electro may have still been too lenient...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, cutie. I knew we'd cross paths again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at, Lisa?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, just these painted utensils in this shop, aren't they exquisite? I'm thinking about buying some to take back for decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And those plates... if we serve tea on them, Jean wouldn't be able to resist, even in the middle of work.

choices.text: I don't think those are for sale.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh, not for sale? Honestly, why put it in the shop if you don't intend to sell it?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: How disappointing! Ah, they're so beautiful, too...

choices.text: I think those are only for display.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey cutie, are you here at the Grand Bazaar to catch some performances?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like the performances here?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Yes, they are quite amusing. I even wonder if I should start taking notes on the formats of some of the programs. Who knows? Perhaps it'll come in handy for the next Ludi Harpastum.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Kaeya could take charge of the jokes, but dancing might prove to be a little tricky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen the dancing here before?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Yes, there was a lovely girl with red hair dancing yesterday. I had a front row seat, it was really something.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I can't help but wonder how great it would be to see similar performances in Mondstadt.

choices.text: You just have to convince Nilou to perform in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Actually, I think the biggest challenge would be to get Eula, Captain of the Reconnaissance Company, to show some interest in dancing, as well as to find a beautiful outfit she would agree to wear.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're trying to get Eula involved?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Eula is surprisingly gullible when it comes to certain things. Rather than inviting the performers to Mondstadt, it would be easier to trick... ah, I mean, ask her to dance.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey! What are you doing around the Akademiya?

choices.text: Are you on your way into the Akademiya?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Actually, I was just leaving.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I had a reunion with Professor Cyrus and some fellow apprentices, as well as other researchers that I worked with in the past.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: How time flies! I could tell just from their appearances that they've been really busy.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I, on the other hand, have had it pretty easy. Hahaha... they must be so jealous.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: That being said, since I've already indulged so much, I should probably eat less cake next month.

choices.text: Oh, so you were on your way out, then?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Mm-hmm, and that's when I ran into you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Its name is Sag? Oh, what a nice puppy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like search and rescue dogs?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Of course. I love obedient puppies, especially the ones that let you rub their belly and look at you with their little sparkling eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Actually, I've always wanted to get a dog. Not only could it help keep me in a good mood, but it could also intimidate others when need be.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But if I got a dog, it'd be too much hassle to groom it and clean up after it all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: That's the trouble with pets. I suppose I'm not really suited to have one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the lady beside you...

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: Hey, keep it down! You mean that lady over there named Lisa?

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: Lisa... Lisa, what a beautiful, elegant name.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: Too bad you didn't see it. She spoke to me just now, asking about Sag's name, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: She also seems to have a love for animals. But she doesn't seem to know how to deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: I could tell by the way she had just touched Sag, but it doesn't matter. I can teach her.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: We could raise lots of dogs together...

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: (He gets lost in thought talking to himself.)

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lisa. I'm fine now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #It's {NICKNAME}! Whatcha doing here?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Do you come to visit Collei often, cutie?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #{M#He}{F#She}'s amazing. All of us in Gandharva Ville already have a lot to thank {M#him}{F#her} for.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Collei and I are very good friends.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well then, it seems my little Collei has been making some new friends in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And I've been doing my best to learn how to read. Now I can even read some simple sentences!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Master and everyone in Sumeru has taken good care of me, but I've never forgotten my friends in Mondstadt. I've actually been thinking about taking some time to go back for a visit.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Miss Lisa, how's everyone doing? Well, I hope? What about Amber? And Kaeya? Oh, and Jean?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, slow down, Collei. I'll tell you all about them...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Sorry, darling, seems I'll need some time here. I want to tell Collei about what's happening in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lisa. I'm fine now.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I came here to visit an old friend, but I had no idea that she'd already become a Trainee Forest Ranger.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hehe, it's nothing, really. I just wanted to help out Master Tighnari.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well then, it seems my little Collei has been making some new friends in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And I've been doing my best to learn how to read. Now I can even read some simple sentences!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Master and everyone in Sumeru has taken good care of me, but I've never forgotten my friends in Mondstadt. I've actually been thinking about taking some time to go back for a visit.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Miss Lisa, how's everyone doing? Well, I hope? What about Amber? And Jean? Oh, and Kaeya...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, slow down, Collei. I'll tell you all about them...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Sorry, darling, seems I'll need some time here. I want to tell Collei about what's happening in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Gafoor
dialogues.text: We need more manpower. How are we supposed to manage with so few people? You know what? Just do as much as you can.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: So you guys met Lisa in Mondstadt? Are you sure she's just a plain old librarian?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, what's so strange about that?

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: I didn't think there was anything about that backwater that would attract her there. Such a waste of talent.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: ... Okay, I know you're Lisa's friend, and I'm not gonna talk to her about that again, so stop giving me that dirty look.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: I was kind enough to offer her a chance, but she didn't seem keen. Fine by me, I guess.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: Yes, we carry out regular monitoring of the workings of Ley Lines. This is one of our fundamental research principles.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: There are not enough talented folk who are professional and can independently undertake the work of exploring the Ley Lines. I've long said that we should allocate more people to come here...

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: Alas, I can't find any researchers, so I have to recruit willing volunteers.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: It's up to you to explore and clean up this Domain.
